statement: For the full once-punctured-torus loop-outer group, every finite p-subgroup injects into GL2(Zp) through its actual p-adic abelianization action. Full abelianization is injective on every finite subgroup, whose order divides24. A cohomology-ring comparison proves unique section conjugacy and an isomorphism on first cohomology from the ambient free profinite group to its actual fixed subgroup whenever an order-p automorphism acts trivially on the maximal pro-p quotient; the punctured-torus cusp then forces that automorphism to be trivial.
where_proved: Part D, statement D.33; work/part_c/d33.tex; code/part_c/torus_homology_d33.py
depends_on: A.7; D.10; D.25; D.27; D.28; D.32; Kochloukova-Zalesskii2007 Theorem2 and Section1.1

depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The once-punctured-torus loop is the specified commutator subgroup, and all comparison maps retain it.
notes: The finite-order lift comes directly from D27 and requires no subsequent conjugation. The primary-homology condition makes its induced pro-p automorphism the identity by the Magnus argument. The cohomology-ring refinement of the Brown calculation gives an isomorphism on H1 of the actual fixed subgroup. A finite-cover boundary character contradicts the commutator's vanishing under that isomorphism unless the fixed subgroup is the whole group. The order-dividing24 bound is unconditional; classification and geometric conjugacy of the remaining finite actions are not asserted.
